 "command": "cat > programs/task-575ac891.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    shapes = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        shapes.append((color, [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] == color else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]))
    h = max(len(shape) for _, shape in shapes)
    w = sum(len(shape[0]) for _, shape in shapes)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    x = 0
    for color, shape in shapes:
        for r in range(len(shape)):
            for c in range(len(shape[0])):
                out[r][x + c] = shape[r][c]
        x += len(shape[0])
    return out

        shapes.append((c0, color, [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] == color else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]))
